description: Data + catalogue substrate for Phase 1: the academics.* permission and audit-action catalogue additions, the five new enums + four new tenant-owned Prisma models (AcademicSession, AcademicTerm, Program, AcademicCalendarDayRevision) + the additive AcademicCalendarDay columns, the NEW phase1_academics migration (composite FKs, partial unique indexes, RLS FORCE with fail-closed/append-only policies, campass_app GRANT refresh, catalogue seed — six FROZEN migrations untouched), applied to live Supabase, and the demo-institution seed extension. This is the foundation FEAT-002 (API) and FEAT-003 (tests) build on; it must leave shared dist current, the Prisma client regenerated, and the DB migrated. Depends on nothing else in this task.
steps: Read c:/campusgate/.agents/tasks/phase1-academics/context.json and this file FIRST. Then skim design.md §3,§4,§7,§8,§9 and the two reference migrations named in context (superadmin_security, module_system).

packages/shared/src/permissions.ts: add four academics-module entries to PERMISSIONS — academics.sessions.manage, academics.programs.manage, academics.calendar.manage, academics.view — and bind in ROLE_PERMISSIONS (ADMIN gains all four; STUDENT, GUARD, HOD each gain academics.view). Leave admin.academic_calendar.manage untouched (retained, route-unused).

packages/shared/src/audit-actions.ts: add twelve module-'academics' keys to AUDIT_ACTIONS — academics.session.created|updated|activated|closed, academics.term.created|updated|activated|closed, academics.program.created|updated, academics.calendar.updated. Do NOT touch LEGACY_AUDIT_ACTION_MAP. Do NOT edit modules.ts.
Rebuild shared: cd packages/shared && npx tsc (refreshes dist so later consumers see the keys).

packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma: add enums AcademicSessionStatus{UPCOMING ACTIVE CLOSED}, AcademicStructureType{SEMESTER TRIMESTER ANNUAL CUSTOM}, AcademicTermStatus{UPCOMING ACTIVE CLOSED}, ProgramStatus{ACTIVE INACTIVE}, ProgramDurationUnit{TERMS YEARS}. Add models AcademicSession, AcademicTerm, Program, AcademicCalendarDayRevision per design §3.2/§4.1/§4.3 (institutionId + institution relation; @@unique([id,institutionId]); @@index([institutionId]); natural-key uniques (institutionId,name) on sessions, (academicSessionId,ordinal) on terms, (institutionId,code) on programs). Add nullable departmentId/academicSessionId/academicTermId (+ optional relations) to AcademicCalendarDay and REMOVE its @@unique([institutionId,date]). Add all back-relations on Institution, Department, AcademicSession, AcademicTerm.

Regenerate the client: from repo root npx prisma generate --schema=packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma (client must regenerate WITHOUT the institutionId_date compound-unique input on academicCalendarDay).

Author the migration: cd packages/db && npx prisma migrate dev --create-only --name phase1_academics (create-only; NEVER plain migrate dev on Supabase). Hand-edit the generated migration.sql to contain, in order: (a) CREATE TYPE the five enums; (b) CREATE TABLE the four new tables with PKs/uniques/indexes; (c) ALTER academic_calendar_days ADD COLUMN the three nullable columns; (d) tenant-root FKs (institutionId->institutions(id) RESTRICT) on all four + composite same-tenant FKs incl. institutionId for academic_terms->academic_sessions (RESTRICT), programs->departments (RESTRICT), and the three academic_calendar_days links (department RESTRICT; session/term SET NULL); (e) DROP INDEX academic_calendar_days_institutionId_date_key and CREATE the two partial unique indexes (_inst_date_institutionwide WHERE departmentId IS NULL; _inst_date_dept WHERE departmentId IS NOT NULL); (f) partial unique academic_sessions_one_active_per_institution (WHERE status='ACTIVE'); (g) DO $$ ENABLE+FORCE RLS on all four — standard nullif-guarded pair on academic_sessions/academic_terms/programs, and the append-only pair (tenant_isolation_select + academic_calendar_day_revisions_tenant_insert, NO modify policy) on the revision table; (h) append-only function academic_calendar_day_revisions_append_only() raising restrict_violation + trigger academic_calendar_day_revisions_no_update_delete BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE; (i) guarded campass_app GRANT (full DML on the three mutable tables; SELECT,INSERT on the revision table + REVOKE UPDATE,DELETE from campass_app on it); (j) seed the four academics.* permissions + role_permissions pairs with the EXACT catalogue-sync markers. No backfill. Do NOT edit any FROZEN migration.
Apply: cd packages/db && npx prisma migrate deploy (retry transient pooler errors). Then from repo root npx prisma generate --schema=packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma again.

packages/db/src/seed.ts: after the membership upserts, add idempotent upserts on the existing institution/bca objects — one AcademicSession '2026-2027' SEMESTER ACTIVE; two AcademicTerms (Semester 1 ordinal 1 ACTIVE, Semester 2 ordinal 2 UPCOMING); two Programs (BCA under bca/512, BTECH-CSE under 501 via institutionId_code), TERMS/duration 6; a few calendar entries (institution-wide HOLIDAY + WORKING_DAY, BCA-dept-scoped EXAM_DAY) via findFirst+create/update linked to the session. Do NOT seed revision rows. Match the seed's console.log style.
acceptance_criteria: cd packages/shared && npx tsc compiles clean and refreshes dist.

npx prisma generate --schema=packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma succeeds and the regenerated client exposes academicSession/academicTerm/program/academicCalendarDayRevision delegates and no longer exposes the academicCalendarDay institutionId_date compound-unique input.
npx prisma migrate deploy exits 0 and lists <ts>_phase1_academics as applied; npx prisma migrate status (from packages/db) shows the DB up to date with exactly seven migrations.
The six pre-existing migration directories are byte-for-byte unchanged (git diff shows only the new migration dir under migrations/).
cd packages/db && npx tsc (or npx tsx --check src/seed.ts) type-checks the extended seed.
verification: cd c:/campusgate/packages/db && npx prisma migrate deploy && npx prisma migrate status
cd c:/campusgate && git diff --stat -- packages/db/prisma/migrations (confirm only the new dir changed)
findings:
DONE & VERIFIED. New migration dir: 20261027111710_phase1_academics (timestamp from system clock which reads 2026-10-27; it sorts AFTER the six frozen dirs). Applied to live Supabase via `prisma migrate deploy` (exit 0); `prisma migrate status` reports 7 migrations, DB up to date. The six frozen dirs are byte-for-byte unchanged (git shows only the new untracked dir under migrations/).

AUTHORING NOTE (deviation from the literal 'migrate dev --create-only' instruction): `prisma migrate dev --create-only` ABORTS because the live _prisma_migrations ledger has a PRE-EXISTING checksum drift on the frozen 20261019053533_superadmin_security migration (ledger checksum fccee0e1..., committed file LF-hash 2bbc63b8...; the file is clean in git, so the drift predates this work and I did NOT cause or touch it). migrate dev wanted to RESET the shared DB, which is forbidden. I did NOT reset. Instead I hand-authored the migration directory following the superadmin_security/module_system house style and used `prisma migrate diff --from-url <DIRECT_URL> --to-schema-datamodel` (read-only) to confirm the exact CREATE TABLE / column / index DDL, then applied with `migrate deploy` (deploy does NOT re-verify applied-migration checksums, so it is unaffected by the pre-existing superadmin drift — confirmed: it applied cleanly and `migrate status` is green). FEAT-003 / any future `migrate dev` will hit the same superadmin ledger drift; it is a separate pre-existing ledger issue, not Phase-1 schema drift.

FINAL ENUM NAMES: AcademicSessionStatus{UPCOMING,ACTIVE,CLOSED}, AcademicStructureType{SEMESTER,TRIMESTER,ANNUAL,CUSTOM}, AcademicTermStatus{UPCOMING,ACTIVE,CLOSED}, ProgramStatus{ACTIVE,INACTIVE}, ProgramDurationUnit{TERMS,YEARS}.
FINAL MODEL/TABLE NAMES: AcademicSession->academic_sessions, AcademicTerm->academic_terms, Program->programs, AcademicCalendarDayRevision->academic_calendar_day_revisions.
KEY FIELD NAMES: Program has (duration:Int, durationUnit:ProgramDurationUnit default TERMS) NOT a single int. AcademicTerm.ordinal is 1-based. AcademicCalendarDay gained nullable departmentId/academicSessionId/academicTermId; its @@unique([institutionId,date]) is REMOVED and replaced by two partial unique indexes (academic_calendar_days_inst_date_institutionwide WHERE departmentId IS NULL; academic_calendar_days_inst_date_dept WHERE departmentId IS NOT NULL). The revision table's calendarDayId/academicSessionId/academicTermId/departmentId are snapshot columns; calendarDayId has NO FK, but academicSessionId/academicTermId DO carry Prisma relation fields (back-relations calendarDayRevisions on AcademicSession/AcademicTerm) with SET NULL FKs in the migration (reconciles design §3.2 back-relations with §4.3 snapshot intent).

CATALOGUE: added academics.* permissions (academics.sessions.manage, academics.programs.manage, academics.calendar.manage, academics.view) and bound ADMIN=all four, STUDENT/GUARD/HOD=academics.view. admin.academic_calendar.manage left untouched (retained, route-unused). audit-actions.ts gained 11 academics.* keys (session.created|updated|activated|closed, term.created|updated|activated|closed, program.created|updated, calendar.updated) — the FEAT-001 step said 'twelve' but its own explicit enumeration and design §7 both specify 11; 11 is correct. Shared rebuilt (dist current). catalogue-sync meta-test passes.

CROSS-FEATURE EDIT (one line, outside FEAT-001's literal file list but required by my catalogue additions): added "20261027111710_phase1_academics" to SEEDING_MIGRATION_DIRS in apps/api/src/services/__tests__/catalogue-sync.test.ts, per context.json's contribution_requirements ('new migration dir added to that array'). Without it the meta-test fails set-equality. All 4 catalogue-sync tests now pass.

EXPECTED HAND-OFF BREAK FOR FEAT-002 (NOT a FEAT-001 failure): removing the academicCalendarDay institutionId_date compound-unique breaks `cd apps/api && npx tsc` at exactly three sites in apps/api/src/routes/admin.ts (lines ~1673, ~1723, ~1734 — the GET/PUT/DELETE academic-calendar handlers still upsert via `where: { institutionId_date: {...} }`). FEAT-002 step 7 explicitly owns rewriting these three handlers to findFirst/create/update keyed on (institutionId, date, departmentId ?? null) + writing an AcademicCalendarDayRevision row in-tx + auditing academics.calendar.updated. FEAT-001's verification deliberately does NOT run apps/api tsc for this reason. FEAT-002 must also add departmentId:null to allowance-engine's academicCalendarDay.findMany (uses the _inst_date_institutionwide partial unique).

SEED: extended packages/db/src/seed.ts (idempotent) — captured the code-501 dept as btechCse; one AcademicSession '2026-2027' SEMESTER ACTIVE (2026-07-01..2027-06-30); two AcademicTerms (Semester 1 ordinal 1 ACTIVE, Semester 2 ordinal 2 UPCOMING); two Programs (BCA under dept 512, BTECH-CSE under dept 501, both duration 6 TERMS); three calendar entries (institution-wide HOLIDAY 2026-08-15 + WORKING_DAY 2026-09-05, BCA-dept-scoped EXAM_DAY 2026-11-20) via findFirst+create/update linked to the session. No revision rows seeded. `cd packages/db && npx tsc` clean.
